ziH_format.header: 8 bytes: u32 LE count + u32 LE field1 (total table size?)

ziH_entry_fields.f0: small int (0xde0, 0xdf6, 0xe10...) - likely entry index or type
ziH_entry_fields.f1: repeating values (0x2c4c8, 0x676) - likely asset type ID
ziH_entry_fields.f2: large offset (0x17cef08...) - likely offset into main.dol or memory
ziH_entry_fields.f3: same as f0 or close - likely secondary index
ziH_entry_fields.f4: same as f1 - likely asset type ID (redundant?)
ziH_entry_fields.f5: large offset (0x17fb3f8...) - likely second memory offset

cross_reference.conclusion: ziH fields are NOT zip local-file-header offsets. They are likely memory offsets or asset IDs used by the game engine to locate/load assets.
